text: dsh-reelsmaker 是一个供 DeepSeek Harness 使用的短视频制作插件，通过 make_reel 工具把多行旁白渲染成 1080×1920 的竖屏 MP4。每行旁白会生成神经语音并显示为画面字幕，插件按音频实际时长安排镜头节拍，也能指定标题、输出目录、语音和语速。它适合需要将已写好的解说稿快速转成短视频的使用者；运行需要 Node.js 20 或更高版本，代码未要求 API 密钥或账户。

dsh-reelsmaker turns narration into vertical MP4 reels with make_reel. Each line gets neural voice-over and a caption, timed by measured audio duration. Users can choose a title, output directory, voice, and rate. Requires Node.js 20+; no API key or account is required.
想把几句解说词变成一段竖屏短视频。
有没有办法给旁白自动配音并烧录字幕？
让 DSH 根据我写好的台词生成 Reels 视频。
我想把每行文案分别做成视频节拍。
需要一个不用填 API key 的神经语音短片制作工具。
能否把旁白和字幕同步后导出 MP4？
Turn my written narration into a vertical reel with voice-over.
Can I create a captioned short video from several script lines?
I need neural narration for a short video without configuring an API key.
Make each sentence a timed beat in an MP4 reel.
dsh-reelsmaker 的功能「配音与字幕」：每行输入文案会成为一个视频节拍，生成对应语音并在画面显示同一行字幕；调用 make_reel 并传入 lines。
dsh-reelsmaker 的功能「按音频时长编排」：插件先生成每行语音并测量 MP3 时长，再为节拍加短暂留白并据此渲染，避免按文字长度估算时长。
dsh-reelsmaker 的功能「导出竖屏 MP4」：Remotion 将内容渲染为 H.264 MP4，默认输出到插件的 out 目录；工具返回路径、秒数和节拍数。
dsh-reelsmaker 的功能「自定义语音和输出」：make_reel 接受标题、输出目录、Edge neural voice ID 和语速参数；语音默认值在配音模块中设置。

dsh-reelsmaker README · dsh-reelsmaker：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that
turns lines of narration into a finished vertical reel — spoken, captioned,
1080×1920, ready to upload.

**No API key. No account. No ffmpeg.**

```
you:  make a reel about why my tool needs no API key
dsh:  [make_reel] Rendering a 5-beat reel…
      Rendered 16.4s reel (5 beats): out/why-my-tool-needs-no-api-key.mp4
```

---

dsh-reelsmaker README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-reelsmaker
```

Or straight from source, which skips the registry entirely:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:aayan-cloud/dsh-reelsmaker
```

Either works: `dsh plugin add` forwards to pnpm, and there is no build step, since
the plugin is plain ESM and Remotion compiles the JSX at render time.

Or try it without the harness at all:

dsh-reelsmaker README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/aayan-cloud/dsh-reelsmaker
cd dsh-reelsmaker && npm install
node lib/make-reel.js "Every reel here is just a text file." "No editor, and nothing dragged onto a timeline." "Free, and open source."
```

---

dsh-reelsmaker README · Why this exists：Every voice plugin in the harness ecosystem today either wants an API key or
falls back to browser speech, and the video plugins render one fixed style.

This uses **Microsoft Edge's neural TTS** — the engine behind Edge's Read Aloud —
which is free and needs no account, and renders with
[Remotion](https://remotion.dev), so the whole chain runs on hardware you already
own.

dsh-reelsmaker README · Why this exists：**The agent writes the words. This makes the video.** The tool takes finished
narration lines rather than a topic on purpose: the harness already has a model
that writes better copy than any template would, so generating the script
internally would replace a good writer with a worse one.

---

dsh-reelsmaker README · The tool：`make_reel` — each line becomes one beat, spoken and shown on screen.

| parameter | | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | required | 4–6 narration lines, under ~12 words each |
| `title` | | output filename, defaults to the first line |
| `outDir` | | where the MP4 lands |
| `voice` | | Edge voice id, e.g. `en-US-AriaNeural` |
| `rate` | | speaking rate, e.g. `+12%` |

Returns `{ path, seconds, beats }`.

---

dsh-reelsmaker README · Two decisions worth knowing about：**Beat lengths are measured, never estimated.** A beat has to be exactly as long
as the line spoken over it. Guessing from character count is close, and close
compounds — across six beats the captions end up a third of a second off the
voice, which reads as broken rather than as a small error. So the pipeline speaks
first, counts the MPEG frames in each MP3 to get an exact duration, and only then
times the beats. There is no ffmpeg anywhere; the frame headers are parsed
directly.

dsh-reelsmaker README · Two decisions worth knowing about：**Captions are burned in, not optional.** Short-form is watched muted by default,
so a reel whose story lives only in the voice track is a reel most viewers never
receive. Every line is spoken *and* shown. The audio is an upgrade for people who
turn it on, never a dependency.

---

dsh-reelsmaker README · Loading it from source on Windows：The harness tutorial says a local plugin path "must be absolute". That is true
on Unix and not sufficient on Windows: a bare `C:/...` path reaches Node's ESM
loader as protocol `c:` and throws `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME` before the
plugin loads. Use a `file://` URL:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: reelsmaker
      name: 'file:///C:/path/to/dsh-reelsmaker/index.js'
```

```sh
dsh web --patch ./dev-patch.yml
```

dsh-reelsmaker README · Loading it from source on Windows：Set `REELSMAKER_PROBE=1` to print a line when the plugin registers, which is how
you tell "loaded and registered" apart from "the config composed but nothing ran".
section: Loading it from source on Windows

text:
dsh-reelsmaker README · Known limits：- **The render is foreground.** It takes 30s–3min depending on length, and the
  call blocks for that time. Moving it to `ctx.jobs.start()` as a background job
  is the obvious upgrade; it is not done yet.
- **One visual style.** Narrated statements on a drifting gradient. It suits
  explainer and announcement reels; it is not a product-video tool. For cinematic
  product work see [video-shotcraft](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft).
- **DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview** and promises
  compatibility-breaking changes, so this will need maintenance.
